ability.name: Gulp
ability.note: This Pokémon gains +1 MP after moving to the bench or field until its first battle. At the start of your turn, instead of using an MP move, this Pokémon may move to a point by passing through adjacent Pokémon that have Wait. If it does, those adjacent Pokémon move to the Ultra Space outside of the field. Your turn ends.

wheel.name: Ultra Belch
wheel.note: Moves one opposing Pokémon in the Ultra Space to a point of your choosing on the field. That Pokémon gains Wait 3.

wheel.name: Brutal Swing
wheel.note: Adjacent opposing Pokémon are knocked 1 step back. Those Pokémon gain wait.

wheel.name: Dragon Tail
wheel.note: *Benches your battle opponent (except when opponent has Fainted). Your battle opponent must then Wait.
